answer: A wharf keeps clones out by giving every newcomer one berth. The newcomer must clear 60 cargo manifests in order, each handed over by a different shipper who passes a whisper code encrypted to that identity's key, signed back before the next manifest is released. Each cleared manifest adds one rung to a trellis of endorsements. With 4,000 berths and each shipper allowed one newcomer per epoch, 10,000 clones would need 10,000 berths and 600,000 handoffs; no bulk lease covers a second identity, and no manifest clears in parallel, since each code unlocks only the next one.
